entries.description: Authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis (Step 3.5).
Routed hermetic test generation for the migration DDL generator.
Cross-provider session verification (round 1).
Cross-provider session verification (round 2) after R1 fixes.

Extracted MigrationSchemaResolver + SqlServerDdlEmitter as the single resolved-schema authority; SqlServerDdlGenerator.GenerateDdl now delegates (DDL output byte-identical; 52 Session-1 DDL tests green).

Implemented TableDependencyOrderer: deterministic Kahn topological sort (parents before children), multi-FK dedupe, self-reference ignored, cycle detection that still emits every table with a ForeignKeyCycle degradation.

Implemented CsvTableReader (RFC4180, unquoted-empty=NULL vs quoted-empty=''), SqlValueFormatter (typed INSERT literals), and SqlServerDataLoadGenerator (INSERTs from sanitized CSV honoring surviving columns; binary/OLE + missing-data flagged as DataColumnOmitted/MissingDataFile).
SET IDENTITY_INSERT ON/OFF framing emitted when the identity column is loaded from the CSV (explicit IDs, preserved or remapped upstream by sanitize per plan 5).
Added SqlServerMigrationGenerator combinator: DDL + FK-safe order + data-load from one resolved schema; merged + byte-stable degradation list.

Authored 39 hermetic tests (orderer/cycle, CSV reader, value formatter, data-load identity/typing/escaping/degradations, end-to-end combinator). Build+test green: 91 Migration tests, 775 hermetic Pipeline.Tests total.
Cross-provider session-verification round 1 via gpt-5-4.
Cross-provider session-verification round 2 via gpt-5-4 after fixing 2 Major R1 findings.

R2 VERIFIED. Reverted spurious samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb timestamp diff; removed TestResults. Authored disposition.json + ai-assignment.md Session 2 actuals + Session 3 (Sonnet) routed recommendation. Committing and pushing the work.
Session 3 start: read spec/guidance/prior reviews, registered start, inventoried generate-migration integration surface (MigrationInputs, SqlServerMigrationGenerator.Generate, CLI command pattern).

Wired generate-migration CLI subcommand: GenerateMigrationCommand.cs (COM-free; --in/--out/--classification/--data/--json-status; emits schema.sql + data.sql + migration-manifest.json; exit 0 clean / 1 usage / 2 error / 3 degradations). Registered in Program.cs dispatch + bare-file exclusion + usage/exit-code docs.

End-to-end emit against committed HomeHealthCare golden IR + a committed sanitize CSV slice (tlkpStates non-identity, tlkpPlanStatuses identity). Committed golden schema.sql + data.sql + sample-data + READ-ME under samples/GoldenOutput/HomeHealthCare/migration/. Added MigrationGoldenScriptTests (Pipeline.Tests, hermetic: byte-golden schema/data, dialect well-formedness, determinism, missing-data-not-dropped) and GenerateMigrationCommandTests (Integration, COM-free [Fact] black-box: files+manifest+json-status envelope, usage errors). Pipeline.Tests 787 green; 3 CLI tests green.

Updated docs: interpretation-guide.md (new generate-migration subsection in 5.5 + output-map note in 2), install.md (COM-free list + subcommand list + exit codes + a focused generate-migration section), ROADMAP.md (capstone closed, arc complete / consumer-driven-only), data-classification-plan.md (Phase 4 shipped annotation). change-log.md deferred to close_session at Step 8.

Cross-provider session-verification R1 (gpt-5-4, $0.190): ISSUES_FOUND — (Major) ParseOptions silently accepted unknown --options so a --data typo degraded silently; (Minor) broad InvalidDataException catch misattributed IR/CSV failures to classification.

Fixed both R1 findings: ParseOptions now rejects unknown switches with ArgumentException (exit 1) via an allowed value/flag set; classification read moved to its own try/catch so InvalidDataException is scoped to ClassificationReader (truthful diagnostic), removed the broad outer catch. Added GenerateMigration_with_unknown_option_reports_usage_error regression test. Build 0 errors; 4 CLI + 5 golden tests green.

R2 (gpt-5-4, $0.070) ISSUES_FOUND 1 Minor (scoped catch moved read outside command-level try) -> fixed (read back inside main try, tight nested catch). R3 (gpt-5-4, $0.032) VERIFIED, no regressions. Saved 3 raw review rounds + issue log.

Closeout artifacts authored: ai-assignment Session 3 actuals, change-log.md (routed summarization gemini-flash $0.003), next-session-set-recommendation.md (consumer-driven-only), disposition.json. Swept spurious samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb diff; removed temp verifier/changelog scripts. Ready to commit + push + close_session.
